newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rex Stores Corp downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rex Stores Corp downgraded.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it lowered its rating on Rex Stores Corp to market performer from outperform on both an intermediate and long-term basis.

--"Our downgrade is due to the fact that we do not see current business as being the bottom of consumer electronics sector and it appears as if there (are) four more down quarters to come," analyst Beth Richards said in a research note.
--EVEREN also lowered its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.98 a share from $1.22 and 1998 to $1.20 from $1.40.
--Shares of the discount electronics store company fell 1-1/4 to 8-1/4 Monday.
